rationale: Multi-Asset Task F. Reserves KRX daily data from 2019-01-01 onward as the holdout for the KR-10 portfolio (configs/research/universes/kr10.json). WHY THE CUTOFF IS 2019-01-01, stated as a fact about what has been DONE to the data rather than a proportion: the KR-10 universe was resolved using 2018 data only -- full-calendar-year traded value for the ordering, and 2018 daily log returns for the C1/C2 correlation constraints (.planning/ms-e-kr10-universe-rule.md, rule committed at d57a4e3 and executed at 85cdfab). Nothing from 2019 onward informed the selection of a single member. 2018 is therefore spent and 2019-onward is untouched, and the cutoff is exactly that boundary. STRUCTURAL SEPARATION, not merely a promise: python/data/backfill_kis.py was run with --start 2019-01-01, so the kline store contains NO KRX bars before the cutoff at all. The 2018 series used for selection lives only in scratch files on the research instance and was never persisted. A research-side load against this config will therefore find nothing, which is correct -- there is no KRX research split, the same whole-window-holdout shape configs/research/holdout_1m.json and holdout_binance_futures_1m.json already use. WINDOW AND POWER: 1882 trading days per member, 2019-01-02 through 2026-09-01, 7.66 calendar years, giving a detection floor of 1.6449/sqrt(years) = 0.5942 annualized Sharpe. That is the lowest floor any window in this project has carried -- BingX 1d holdout was 0.9567, Binance futures 1m 0.623 -- and it sits below the 0.4-0.8 band credible institutional trend-following reports. VERIFIED COVERAGE: all eleven stored series (ten members plus the KOSPI reference calendar) hold exactly 1882 bars over the identical range, and backfill_kis --verify exits 0 with every member complete against the index calendar; 245.4 trading days per year matches the real KRX rate. DISCLOSED, because it is the one thing this window cannot settle: KIS serves no expired single-stock-futures contract history, so nothing here verifies that a given member had a listed, liquid future on a given past date. Futures execution across this window is an UNVERIFIED PREMISE the consuming pre-registration must state as such -- see .planning/ms-b-kis-history-probe-result.md section 2.1. WRITTEN BEFORE ANY SCORING: no backtest of any kind has been run against KRX data. The universe resolution read 2018 prices and volumes and nothing else.
notes: symbol is the universe identifier, not a store symbol. Members are listed in configs/research/universes/kr10.json; each is stored under its own KRX: or KRX-INDEX: symbol.
The cutoff is fixed at the value it held on set_on and must not be moved. Unlike BingX, KRX history is not a rolling window, so it will not drift -- but the rule is the same.
